description: Returns the accounts this creator follows, one page at a time (page with cursor). The first call for an account usually returns {"status":"collecting","retryAfterSeconds":N} instead of a page: that is "not ready yet", not an error and not billed — call this tool again with the same uid after retryAfterSeconds (up to 120), and stop after about 3 minutes. COST: each collection from TikTok costs 4,000 credits and adds up to 150 accounts; asking for a page past what is already collected, or reading the list again after 12 hours, collects (and charges) again, while a page already collected costs 1 credit. Fetch only the pages the user asked for, and ask before paging through a long list. A private account or a hidden list returns isPrivate: true with no entries.

uid.description: Creator handle (with or without @), profile URL, or stored user id.

name: creators_following
